channel.title: Audio & Video Gems
channel.description: Software, solutions and add-ons for audio & video — open source first.

item.title: Ultra Video Editor 1.4.6
item.description: Open-source (GPL-3.0) video editor built by a blind developer, fully keyboard-driven with JAWS and NVDA. 1.4.6 (Oct 21) generates audio description: Gemini watches the video, writes an editable script fitted to the pauses, and a voice mixes it in. Windows.

item.title: melcom's FFmpeg Audio Normalizer 4.1.2
item.description: Open-source (MIT) GUI to loudness-normalize batches of audio files with FFmpeg. 4.1.2 (Oct 22) adds analysis reports (loudness, True Peak, dynamics), CSV export, optional output verification and fixes two-pass processing. Windows.

item.title: Grain Freezer 1.0.0 (Amazing Noises)
item.description: Free plugin that freezes 150 ms of any sound into a granular cloud (up to 64 grains), manually or automatically in sync with tempo, blendable with the live input. No account or email; AU and VST3, macOS only.

item.title: KIYMA (SubverseLab)
item.description: Free glitch/stutter effect that minces the last bars played, locked to the DAW tempo, with no latency and no randomness: same settings, same result. Five presets, from LEAN to BONE. VST3/AU/standalone on macOS, VST3 on Windows; free account required.

item.title: Swanky Amp Free 2.0.1
item.description: Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) tube amp simulation that reacts to your touch, with sag and note bloom. v2 (Oct 20) brings a new interface, a more accurate tone stack, auto oversampling and CLAP support (VST3, AU, standalone; Windows and macOS).

item.title: Why Dit (Teroof Plugins)
item.description: Free one-knob stereo widener, plus a “rainbow” switch for extra bloom: adds air and space to a vocal or a full mix. VST3 (Windows, macOS) and AU (macOS).

item.title: MusE 4.3
item.description: The free MIDI/audio sequencer (GPL-2.0) for Linux releases 4.3 on Oct 19, three years after 4.2.1: variable note-name lists (microtonal), adjustable middle C, a reworked advanced routing dialog, a fully undoable effect rack and many VST/LV2 fixes. Last Qt5 release.

item.title: SQ8L 1.0.0 beta 3 (64-bit port)
item.description: A 64-bit port of SQ8L, the free Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation long stuck on 32-bit Windows: sample-identical sound, old projects and banks load unchanged, as VST2/VST3/AU/CLAP plus LV2 on Linux. Port code under MIT, still in beta.

item.title: LosslessCut 3.70.1
item.description: The free tool (GPL-2.0) for cutting and remuxing video and audio without re-encoding reaches 3.70 (Oct 19): bundled FFmpeg 8.1 (fixes a CVE), a much richer metadata editor, more accurate MKV/WebM cuts and a light/dark theme. On Windows, get 3.70.1.

item.title: Concat 0.2.7 (beta)
item.description: A free CapCut alternative (AGPL-3.0) in Rust with a GPU compositor: Whisper auto-captions, TTS and voice cloning, background removal, keyframes and up to 4K60 10-bit export, all local, no watermark or account. Scriptable via JSON-RPC and an MCP server.

item.title: SoundCraft 0.8.0
item.description: A free DAW (Apache-2.0) in Rust following the Pro Tools workflow, Edit and Mix windows, with CLAP/VST3/AU plugins, automation, MIDI, up to 9.1.6 surround and a picture track to sync sound to video. Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD and browser; 0.8.0 out Oct 18.

item.title: TDR Nova 2.2.3
item.description: Tokyo Dawn Labs’ free dynamic EQ, a mixing staple, reaches 2.2.3 with a native Linux build (x86-64 archive) and a fix for right-click in DaVinci Resolve. The GE edition stays paid.

item.title: StageRig 0.1.75
item.description: A free (GPL-3.0) live plugin host for Linux: one program per sound, switched from the keyboard, a footswitch or a tablet that mirrors and drives each plugin’s own GUI in the browser, no app to install. A very young project (.deb/.rpm).

item.title: Kdenlive 26.11.70 (26.12 pre-release)
item.description: The Kdenlive team is asking for testers (Oct 16) for two 26.12 features: relative paths in project files, so an edit moves between drives, OSes or network shares without missing media, and multiple font styles in one Title Editor text block.

item.title: Aeons Light EQ 2.0.0 (Harmonic EQ)
item.description: An EQ whose 8 bands follow the note’s pitch and harmonics in real time (audio, MIDI or sidechain), shaping a moving vocal or bass line without automation. Native Linux VST3/CLAP; full version free with a countdown screen, $25 license on sale.

item.title: Formator 1.0.0
item.description: A free wavetable synth built on the core of the Soviet Formanta P432 (its ROM waves and programs carried over bit for bit), plus extra oscillators, a wave editor, filters and effects. VST3 and standalone on Linux, VST2/VST3 on Windows.

item.title: Pointless Audio: 6 free plugins
item.description: Pointless Audio’s whole catalog is free until October 25: a 1987 four-track cassette strip, BBD delay, mouse-playable springs, a combo organ, a tube strip… emulations that model the wear, not the machine when new. VST3/AU/CLAP, macOS and Windows.

item.title: FilmCraft 0.8.0
item.description: Free (MIT/Apache) take on the Premiere Pro workflow, in pure Rust: editing, a Lumetri-style panel, mixing, AAF/FCPXML exchange and 650+ commands drivable from a CLI or an MCP server. 0.8.0 (Oct 14) adds 32-bit audio export; a young project.

item.title: oscmix 2.0.11
item.description: Free mixer for RME Fireface interfaces (UCX II, UFX III, 802…) in class-compliant mode, where TotalMix doesn’t exist on Linux. 2.0.11 (pre-release, Oct 15) adds 8 fader groups, two aux FX buses and a web UI that keeps its state on reload.

item.title: Plugin Alliance: 6 free plugins
item.description: Six mixing and mastering plugins free with a free account: bx_masterdesk (analog mastering), bx_console N, the 254E compressor, bx_refinement V3, bx_boom V3 and Soft Limit. Installed via the Mac/Windows manager; offer reported on Oct 16.

item.title: ChipTune (beta)
item.description: Morphoice synth recreating the Commodore 64 SID chip, bit-accurately modelled at the original clock (6581 and 8580): solo, chiptune arpeggio and 16-voice poly modes, Juno-style chorus. Free pay-what-you-want beta (Oct 16); the final version may be paid.

item.title: Cali Reverb (Nembrini Audio)
item.description: High-gain guitar amp modelled on a 50 W Mesa Boogie Rectoverb head, normally paid, free for a few days only (promo reported on Oct 16): all you need is a Nembrini Audio account to grab it.

item.title: Subtitle Edit 5.3.0
item.description: Stable 5.3.0 (Oct 14; already covered as RC2 on the 11th): command palette, DVD import, multi-track remux, FFmpeg player with GPU decoding, local ACE-Step music, and updated ASR/TTS/translation engines (whisper.cpp 1.9.5, FFmpeg 9.0.2).

item.title: FrameTrellis 1.2.0
item.description: Free video editor (GPL-3, C++/Qt/MLT/FFmpeg): 1.2.0 (Oct 15) adds multi-clip duplication, an audio/image attribute clipboard, batch mute and frame-by-frame nudging. H.264 MP4 export; Windows (installer) and Linux (source).

item.title: Bagels V2
item.description: Free resonant synth (VST3/AU/CLAP/standalone) for Windows, macOS and Linux: three banks of four resonators and a combined spectrum. V2 (spotted Oct 15) polishes the UI, cuts CPU use sharply (SIMD) and adds a limiter, presets and fast partials.

item.title: VinylNoize
item.description: Free vinyl plugin (Win/Mac/Linux, VST3/AU/LV2) that rebuilds real record playback rather than noise loops: engine calibrated on a measured LP, physical turntable model, and a Deck mode (scratching, braking). Free release reported on Oct 15.

item.title: Aetheriae 1.0.0
item.description: Free texture synth (Morphor): up to 8 sources per voice (granular, 6-op FM, phase distortion, resonators, wavetables), BBD and lo-fi chain, 282 presets. VST3/AU/CLAP/standalone for Mac and Windows, plus a browser version; v1.0.0, spotted Oct 15.

item.title: Synpathy 2.0
item.description: Free string machine (VST3/AU/AAX/standalone) built around sympathetic resonance: held voices feed each other. 2.0 (Oct 15) replaces the engine for a livelier field; three knobs (Form, Aura, Synpathy), Mac and Windows.

item.title: Kdenlive 26.08.2
item.description: Second maintenance release of KDE’s free video editor (Oct 13): the Dynamic Text filter can count frames from 1, handy for animation, plus some thirty fixes to proxies (including NVIDIA encoding), the titler, audio levels and audio recording.

item.title: PySceneDetect 0.7.2
item.description: Automatic shot and cut detection for video, as a CLI or a Python library (BSD-3). 0.7.2 (Oct 12) exports cuts as a keyframes file for Aegisub, recalibrates its histogram and hash detectors on benchmarks and supports PyAV 19.

item.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 (fish-speech 3.0.0 beta)
item.description: Open-weights “directed” speech synthesis model (Oct 13): voice cloning, acting cues ([laughs], <whisper>), retaking a line from a simple note, scenes with up to 16 voices and editing one word in existing audio. ~80 languages; 48 GB GPU required.

item.title: pyVideoTrans 4.16
item.description: Translates a video from one language to another: transcription, translation, dubbing and burned-in subtitles (GPL-3). 4.16 (Oct 13) adds a French web UI and an audio.cpp dubbing backend, and fixes Edge-TTS’s 403 error.

item.title: Mr.Warmer
item.description: Free saturator designed for mastering: physical model of a 12AX7 triode whose harmonics follow the envelope, Tilt EQ before the tube, adjustable Mid/Side saturation, ×8 oversampling and gain compensation. VST3/AAX (Win, Mac) and AU; spotted Oct 13.

item.title: UN/T-01
item.description: Free two-engine drum machine: 6 tracks of 808 synthesised like the original circuits, or a sample player (your own samples too), 32-step polymetric sequencer with Euclid, built-in effects and 48 presets. VST3, CLAP, AU and standalone, Mac and Windows; released Oct 13.

item.title: Phase Align 1.0.0
item.description: Free plugin (AGPL) that aligns two tracks from the same source (close/room mic, DI/amp): ±4 ms delay, phase rotation, polarity, correlation meter, and ANALYSE, which suggests the right setting. v1.0.0 released Oct 9 as VST3/AU for Windows, macOS and Linux.

item.title: DuckingSpace 1.1
item.description: Free reverb (GPL-3) with built-in ducking: it steps back while the sound plays and blooms in the silences, with no bus or sidechain. 1.1 (Oct 11) comes to Mac (VST3/AU) and adds a HALL engine, 13 presets and a redesigned interface.

item.title: ToneShiftEQ 1.3.0
item.description: Free 12-band EQ (BSD-3) by brummer10: minimum-phase FFT convolution or biquads, zero latency, per-band dynamics and a real-time spectrum. 1.3.0 (Oct 8) fixes VST3 and LV2; available as CLAP, VST3, LV2 and standalone for Linux and Windows.

item.title: Drumlabooh 13.0.0
item.description: Free drum machine (GPL-3) in LV2/VST3 that reads Hydrogen and SFZ kits and its own format. Version 13 (Oct 8) brings Diskach, a 90s kit of 7 instruments × 128 variations, kit format 1.1, and skips incompatible SFZ kits instead of crashing the DAW.

item.title: Subtitle Edit 5.3.0 RC2
item.description: The free subtitle editor is preparing 5.3: release candidate 2 published on Oct 11, with builds for Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (tarball and Flatpak), plus SeConv, its command-line subtitle converter.

item.title: OBS Studio 33.0 RC1
item.description: Already covered on Oct 7 as beta 6: OBS 33.0 reaches release candidate (Oct 9). Browser sources fixed (blank page on refresh, local network requests), Plugin Manager made more reliable in safe mode: the final release is getting close.

item.title: MediaMTX 1.21.2
item.description: Ready-to-use live stream server and proxy (SRT, WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP, LL-HLS, Media-over-QUIC) that publishes, records and plays back audio and video. 1.21.2 (Oct 8) closes open access to the playback server and filters non-standard SEI from some cameras.

item.title: whisper.cpp 1.9.5
item.description: Whisper transcription in pure C/C++, running locally on CPU or GPU, ideal for subtitling without the cloud. 1.9.5 (Oct 6) ships ggml 0.26.0: CUDA, Metal and WebGPU optimisations, and sparse flash attention on Vulkan.

item.title: FFmpeg 9.0.2 “Lei”
item.description: The encoding engine behind Blender, OBS and Shotcut moves to 9.0: AI filters on GPU via ONNX Runtime, 360° video in Vulkan, animated WebP, accelerated ProRes RAW on Mac. 9.0.2 (Sept 18) adds security fixes.

item.title: Audacity 4.0.1
item.description: Audacity 4 rebuilds its interface on Qt: selectable and groupable clips, workspaces, ASIO on Windows. 4.0.1 (Sept 30) fixes teething bugs and adds exporting one track or one region per file, plus a portable Windows version.

item.title: OBS Studio 33.0 beta 6
item.description: OBS 33 (beta 6, Oct 3) overhauls plugin loading, with a new folder for third-party plugins that IT should plan for. Also on the menu: updated browser source engine (CEF 150), reworked source snapping and NVENC on Arm64.

item.title: Shotcut 26.9.27 (+ MLT 7.42.0)
item.description: The free editor adds automatic audio ducking, per-track volume and VU meter, and an “Adjustment Clip” that filters every track below it. Moves to FFmpeg 9.0 and fixes download vulnerabilities: update recommended.

item.title: Aegisub 3.5.0
item.description: The reference ASS subtitle editor releases 3.5.0 (Oct 4): zoom and pan in the video, much better High-DPI, native Apple Silicon builds. It fixes a flaw where a crafted file could execute code: update now.

item.title: Shutter Encoder 20.4
item.description: All the power of FFmpeg without a terminal: proxies, ProRes/DNx, cutting without re-encoding. 20.4 (Sept 28) adds a film grain filter, peak normalisation and duplicate frame removal for all codecs.

item.title: Image Sequence to MP4 (Blender add-on) 2.0.0
item.description: Your PNG/EXR renders become an MP4 (H.264, H.265 or AV1) in one click, in the background, without blocking Blender. 2.0.0 (Oct 2) detects missing frames, respects color management and offers Web, 720p and 9:16 presets.

item.title: slatefree 1.2.0
item.description: Rust command-line tool that syncs hundreds of multicam clips with no slate or timecode, lined up on a recorder’s continuous audio. Output: an FCP 7 XML timeline for Resolve and a per-clip check CSV. Repo created Oct 6, already at v1.2.0.
